item.title: Morph Channel Explained: Separating Value, State Evidence, and Fee Responsibility on CKB (1 posts)
item.description: Great write-up. I fully agree with the core direction: funding and state should be decoupled. This is the kind of design space where the Cell model is more expressive than the Bitcoin UTXO. Perun on CKB also adopts a decoupled approach, a comparison between Morph and Perun’s ways of decoupling would be interesting. I also like the version-based design using state_number. It avoids much of the revoked-transaction machinery used in penalty-based channels, and it takes advantage of CKB’s programmability instead of working around missing transaction semantics. This is why Generic Payment Channel Construction and Its Composability uses a monotonically increasing nonce to manage state versions....

item.title: [DIS] Fiber Desktop v1 ground-up rebuild and launch — fnn desktop app (1 posts)
item.description: Update: Fiber Studio + New Repo Quick v1 note: we are moving from the prototype working title “Fiber Desktop” to “Fiber Studio”, the product name for the ground-up rebuild. Why? “Fiber Desktop” worked for the prototype, but it sounds more like a repository name than a product people install. It also ties the project to a single platform. Fiber Studio keeps the Fiber/CKB connection while better reflecting the v1 vision: a workspace for running official fnn, not just a desktop wrapper. New repo (active v1 development): github.com GitHub - chukwuma619/fiber-studio Contribute to chukwuma619/fiber-studio development by creating an account on GitHub.
